audit.why: Soul Unbound is 22s at rank 1, 10s max; Fate Sealed 120/100/80s; Spirit Cleave ~14s base scaling with attack speed.

edits.before: - Yone Soul Unbound: matchup-defining — His burst window — survive it and punish the body he snaps back to. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your E Eviscerate like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Yone Soul Unbound: 22s at rank 1, 10s max — his burst window; survive it and punish the body he snaps back to. - Fate Sealed runs 120/100/80s — a spent ult is your all-in signal. - Guard your E like a fifth summoner spell.

edits.before: W-diving into held CC — the lock-on telegraphs, the dogs can't dodge, and the lane's one button answers everything.
edits.after: Without the pack you lose the brawl — his every-second-hit passive and W shield grind a lone Naafiri down fast.

edits.before: Yone wins by landing Soul Unbound, denying your pattern, and starting the fight your kit wanted ten seconds later.
edits.after: Yone wins by stacking Q on the wave, snapping Soul Unbound onto you, and cashing Q3 into Fate Sealed the moment you dive.

edits.before: You are the flank with a head count: R the approach, W through the front line, and let the hounds peel-proof the exit.
edits.after: Late his build is squishy — punish every overextended Soul Unbound: the body he must snap back to is the pick you take.
